title: baum tile type file
description: One saved tile type, as baum's Tile library exports it (<name>.baumtile.json, at most 3 MiB) and imports it. It maps one to one onto the built-in library's directory layout: type.json (the definition's name, title, use_when, sizes and kit, with glance and applies_with), fill.md, review_checks.md, schema.json, tile.html and samples/. The definition carries no digest: an import computes it, and never takes one or a built-in marking from the file. Samples are synthetic, in a made-up repository, so a file carries no review content. An import also checks everything this schema cannot: the definition's own checks (the data schema's dialect, a supported kit, UTF-8, no NUL), the kit's lint, the samples against the data schema with every citation resolving to the sample's own hunks and items, and the name rules.

definition.description: The tile type's definition (tiles.TypeDefinition) without its digest.

name.description: The type's name, which is also its tiles' ID. An import renames a name already in the library with a numeric suffix.

use_when.description: When the type applies and when it does not, on one line.

fill.description: The instructions given to the review agent when the type is filled.

data_schema.description: The schema of the tile's data, in the restricted dialect of custom tiles.

kit.description: The major version of the tile kit the component was written for.

glance.description: One line on what the glance shows, for the composer.

review_checks.description: What the review should check when the type applies.

applies_with.description: Top-level arrays of the data that show what the type is for.

paths.description: Globs of the files the type is for; none means every pull request.

samples.description: Synthetic samples, each with the hunks and items its data cites.

exported.description: When and by which baum the file was written; informative only.
